explainer_content.short_definition: Classical-coded and instrumental popular music made legible through pop albums, crossover voices, and cinematic mood.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Andrea Bocelli, Enya, Pavarotti, Einaudi, Lang Lang, Yo-Yo Ma, and adjacent artists show how classical signifiers travel into popular listening.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It gives listeners a route into grand, calm, or cinematic sound without requiring formal classical-canon literacy.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The feeling of classical scale matters more than strict classical repertoire or performance practice.
